# Observed JetBrains identifier step

Captured from `https://account.jetbrains.com/login` on 2026-09-20. The observed
form, field metadata and native Continue submit remain; values, scripts, SVGs
and non-structural attributes were removed. CSS and production event handlers
are absent. No auth-session query parameter or account data is retained.

Tests load this real structure. Password-step transitions and fill values are
synthetic, explicitly not a reproduction of JetBrains server behavior or proof
of production authentication.
